summary: The operator-level Marcinkiewicz theorem `lintegral_rpow_operator_le` is added but never used: `lintegral_rpow_maximalFunction_le` re-invokes the distributional theorem and re-derives the same constant by hand, leaving two parallel routes to the strong bound. Several proof steps also re-derive named Mathlib indicator/enorm lemmas.
